$schema: TASKCHORD QUALITY GATES STANDARD (installed from the user-level quality-gates skill, 2026-09-04). Single source of truth for the quality loop; the drift-guard tests in tests/quality-gates.guard.test.ts and the authoritative config files referenced below (package.json scripts, vitest.config.ts include patterns) MUST stay aligned. Changes require a new append-only decision record in docs/decisions/.
boyScoutRule: Every touched file is left cleaner than it was found (small in-scope improvements allowed during any lane; anything larger becomes an out-of-scope finding with a re-entry trigger).

testLanes.entry: pnpm test:unit (vitest run; discovery scoped by the include patterns in vitest.config.ts)
testLanes.heavyToolingRule: no dotnet in this repo; pnpm/vitest runs are light and need no cross-lane heavy-run coordination (if a dotnet tool is ever invoked here, run `dotnet build-server shutdown` after it)

staticGates.linterFormatter: biome via `pnpm check` (biome.json is authoritative); zero new findings on changed surfaces
staticGates.typecheck: typescript via `pnpm typecheck` (project references built through @taskchord/contracts first); no new type errors on changed surfaces
languageRules: workspace packages communicate through @taskchord/* package contracts; no deep imports across package boundaries
no credential literals in source, config or tests; secrets come from the environment
public behavior of packages/proof and packages/work carries tests before it changes

reviewGates.adversarialReview: independent review per candidate; writer != verifier; writer never commits/pushes (manager handoff)
reviewGates.reviewProtocol: reviewer reads the full delta adversarially; unsandboxed lane run output is the evidence for tests/docs-only changes
reviewGates.writerVerifierSelection: writer pool, model and effort selection come from C:/Users/OP/.agents/skills/capability-router/SKILL.md

dependencyAudit.cadence: per sweep + record tails even when clean

securityGates.secretHygiene: no credential literals in source/config/tests; secrets from environment or secret service

codeHealthSweep.cadence: after every accepted merge + at least monthly
checks: dependency vulnerability + freshness audit (pnpm audit, pnpm outdated)
codeHealthSweep.outOfScopeFindings: recorded one-line with a re-entry trigger

legacySweep.principle: existing code is held to the same gates as new code - package-by-package bounded slices
